info.title: Notitek common notification command API
info.description: Proposed implementation contract, 2026-10-11. One extensible command API for authorized SuperPlatform services; JSON fields are snake_case per platform convention. R1 sources call it over REST (Order from its outbox dispatcher); broker integration is deferred. See README.md for runtime invariants, profiles and policies. Inbox, Push registration, provider webhooks and the User link-reissue API remain separate contracts.

get.description: Exactly one of source_ref or subject_ref. source_ref returns one snapshot (404 if absent/not visible). subject_ref returns a cursor page ordered by created_at desc, newest first, limited to the authenticated source unless the caller holds an operations permission. Combining both, or cursor/page_size with source_ref, is 400 INVALID_REQUEST (runtime check).

ServiceAccessToken.description: OAuth2 client-credentials access token issued by User/Authorization. Validate issuer/audience/expiry and source registration; token endpoint belongs to platform configuration.

WorkspaceContext.description: organization_id is the Organization (SHOP, CORPORATION, ...). Required organization type per profile is a runtime check against User.

ShopAudience.description: Members of the Shop organization in context holding notification.order_alert.receive.

subject_ref.description: Business object the notification is about (Order: order_id). Not a deduplication key; used for listing and operations lookup.

SendRequest.description: Common extensible envelope. Server MUST additionally validate the registered (type,type_version) profile; unknown/unavailable type rejected. Per-value UTF-8 limit 2048 bytes and total body 65536 bytes are runtime checks. Source/environment come from authentication/deployment, never payload.

attempt_count.description: Provider attempts started for this delivery.

next_attempt_at.description: Next scheduled retry; null when no retry is scheduled.

code.description: Stable machine code; see x-error-codes. Consumers must handle unknown codes by HTTP status.

OpsAudience.description: Internal operations/CS members holding notification.order_ops_alert.receive whose data scope covers the Shop organization in context.

ConsigneeContact.description: Order receiver (not a platform account). Supplied by Order on every milestone; used only when the milestone policy messages the receiver.

recipients.description: Consignee contact optional; omit it when the milestone policy does not message the receiver (data minimisation).
